title: Luau Script Dumper
features:
Dumps functions, values, tables, userdata Extracts upvalues from functions (optional) Works on decompile-protected LocalScripts Recursive table traversal with cycle protection

Safe handling of: Instance function userdata boolean nil

Configurable via flags Output to console and/or file Clean, sectioned output format
script:
-- Read more info on https://github.com/salamshegol/luau-script-dumper
-- frvgmxnt

getgenv().Flags = {
    ["only-functions"] = false,
    ["only-values"] = false,
    ["no-functions"] = false,
    ["no-tables"] = false,
    ["no-userdata"] = false,
    ["no-upvalues"] = false,
    ["no-writing"] = true,
    ["no-printing"] = false
}

getgenv().FilePath = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.UrScript -- IMPORTANT TO CHANGE IT TO YOUR ACTUAL SCRIPT PATH!!

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salamshegol/luau-script-dumper/refs/heads/main/main.lua"))()
